Definition: Chelets, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Helez the Pelonite, also called the Paltite, is one of David's mighty men and the captain of the seventh course, of the children of Ephraim, with twenty-four thousand in his course. He is named in the roll of the thirty and in the order of the captains.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Helez shows that a mighty man is also an ordered man: he fights in the thirty and he commands in his month, and both are service to the king.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
